scripts.lect-effect/clean:build:lint: pnpm run lect-effect/clean && pnpm run lect-effect/build && pnpm run lect-effect/lint
scripts.lect-effect/clean: pnpm -C packages/domain lect-effect/packages/domain/clean && pnpm run clean
scripts.lect-effect/build: pnpm -C packages/domain lect-effect/packages/domain/build && pnpm run buildtest
scripts.buildtest: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:test
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm run docs:generate:app && pnpm -C packages/domain run docs:generate
scripts.migrate:masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.migrate:test-masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env.test --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d TEST_MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.test: pnpm run buildtest && env-cmd -f .env.test --no-override vitest run --no-file-parallelism
